title: Psalm 85: Revive Us Again
summary: The psalm remembers a time when God showed favor to his land, restored Jacob, and forgave his people's sin. Yet the people are in trouble again, and they ask God to turn from his anger and revive them. A voice then listens for God's answer and hears a promise of peace: steadfast love and faithfulness meet, righteousness and peace kiss, and the land yields its harvest.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 85
from.text: The psalm is a communal lament

line: Remembering past mercy, the people ask God to revive them again, and a voice listens and hears a promise of peace: loving devotion and faithfulness meet, righteousness and peace kiss.
guide: If you have known God's mercy before and find yourself in trouble again, pray from that place: remember past mercy and ask for it again. Notice verse 8, where someone chose to listen before the promises came.

stanzas.title: A plea: restore us and revive us again
Listening for God's word of peace
Love, faithfulness, righteousness, and peace meet

verses.t: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
